verses.original: וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשּׁוּחִ֗י וַיֹאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an bil·daḏ haš·šū·ḥî wa·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Bildad the Shuhite . . . replied
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO respondendo Bildade o suíta, disse:

verses.original: עַד־ אָ֥ן תְּמַלֶּל־ אֵ֑לֶּה וְר֥וּחַ כַּ֝בִּיר אִמְרֵי־ פִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- ’ān tə·mal·lel- ’êl·leh wə·rū·aḥ kab·bîr ’im·rê- p̄î·ḵā
verses.literal: How long . . . will you go on saying such things The words of your mouth are a blustering wind
verses.literalPt: Até quando falarás tais coisas, e as palavras da tua boca serão como um vento impetuoso?

verses.original: הַ֭אֵל יְעַוֵּ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְאִם־ שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יְעַוֵּֽת־ צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’êl yə·‘aw·wêṯ miš·pāṭ wə·’i·mō·ša- šad·dai yə·‘aw·wêṯ- ṣe·ḏeq
verses.literal: Does God pervert justice Does the Almighty pervert what is right
verses.literalPt: Porventura perverteria Deus o direito? E perverteria o Todo-Poderoso a justiça?

verses.original: אִם־ בָּנֶ֥יךָ חָֽטְאוּ־ ל֑וֹ וַֽ֝יְשַׁלְּחֵ֗ם בְּיַד־ פִּשְׁעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- bā·ne·ḵā ḥā·ṭə·’ū- lōw way·šal·lə·ḥêm bə·yaḏ- piš·‘ām
verses.literal: When your children sinned against Him He gave them over . . . to their rebellion
verses.literalPt: Se teus filhos pecaram contra ele, também ele os lançou na mão da sua transgressão.

verses.original: אִם־ אַ֭תָּה תְּשַׁחֵ֣ר אֶל־ אֵ֑ל וְאֶל־ שַׁ֝דַּ֗י תִּתְחַנָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’at·tāh tə·ša·ḥêr ’el- ’êl wə·’e·lō·ša- šad·dai tiṯ·ḥan·nān
verses.literal: But if you would earnestly seek . . . God . . . and ask the Almighty for mercy
verses.literalPt: Mas, se tu de madrugada buscares a Deus, e ao Todo-Poderoso pedires misericórdia;

verses.original: אִם־ זַ֥ךְ וְיָשָׁ֗ר אָ֥תָּה כִּי־ עַ֭תָּה יָעִ֣יר עָלֶ֑יךָ וְ֝שִׁלַּ֗ם נְוַ֣ת צִדְקֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- zaḵ wə·yā·šār ’āt·tāh kî- ‘at·tāh yā·‘îr ‘ā·le·ḵā wə·šil·lam nə·waṯ ṣiḏ·qe·ḵā
verses.literal: if you are pure and upright even now He will rouse Himself on your behalf and restore your righteous estate
verses.literalPt: Se fores puro e reto, certamente logo despertará por ti, e restaurará a morada da tua justiça.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה רֵאשִׁיתְךָ֣ מִצְעָ֑ר וְ֝אַחֲרִיתְךָ֗ יִשְׂגֶּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh rê·šî·ṯə·ḵā miṣ·‘ār wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯə·ḵā yiś·geh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Though your beginnings were modest your latter days will flourish . . .
verses.literalPt: O teu princípio, na verdade, terá sido pequeno, porém o teu último estado crescerá em extremo.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שְׁאַל־ נָ֭א לְדֹ֣ר רִישׁ֑וֹן וְ֝כוֹנֵ֗ן לְחֵ֣קֶר אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- šə·’al- nā lə·ḏōr rî·šō·wn wə·ḵō·w·nên lə·ḥê·qer ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Please . . . inquire of past generations and consider the discoveries of their fathers
verses.literalPt: Pois, eu te peço, pergunta agora às gerações passadas; e prepara-te para a inquirição de seus pais.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תְמ֣וֹל אֲ֭נַחְנוּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע כִּ֤י צֵ֖ל יָמֵ֣ינוּ עֲלֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯə·mō·wl ’ă·naḥ·nū wə·lō nê·ḏā‘ kî ṣêl yā·mê·nū ‘ă·lê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For we were born yesterday and know . . . nothing our days on earth are but a shadow
verses.literalPt: Porque nós somos de ontem, e nada sabemos; porquanto nossos dias sobre a terra são como a sombra.

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם י֭וֹרוּךָ יֹ֣אמְרוּ לָ֑ךְ וּ֝מִלִּבָּ֗ם יוֹצִ֥אוּ מִלִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- hêm yō·w·rū·ḵā yō·mə·rū lāḵ ū·mil·lib·bām yō·w·ṣi·’ū mil·lîm
verses.literal: Will they not teach you and tell you and speak . . . from their understanding
verses.literalPt: Porventura não te ensinarão eles, e não te falarão, e do seu coração não tirarão palavras?

verses.original: הֲיִֽגְאֶה־ גֹּ֭מֶא בְּלֹ֣א בִצָּ֑ה יִשְׂגֶּה־ אָ֥חוּ בְלִי־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yiḡ·’eh- gō·me bə·lō ḇiṣ·ṣāh yiś·geh- ’ā·ḥū ḇə·lî- mā·yim
verses.literal: Does papyrus grow where there is no marsh Do reeds flourish without water
verses.literalPt: Porventura cresce o junco sem lodo? Ou cresce a espadana sem água?

verses.original: עֹדֶ֣נּוּ בְ֭אִבּוֹ לֹ֣א יִקָּטֵ֑ף וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָל־ חָצִ֣יר יִיבָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·ḏen·nū ḇə·’ib·bōw lō yiq·qā·ṭêp̄ wə·lip̄·nê ḵāl ḥā·ṣîr yî·ḇāš
verses.literal: While the shoots are still uncut . . . they dry up more quickly than grass
verses.literalPt: Estando ainda no seu verdor, ainda que não cortada, todavia antes de qualquer outra erva se seca.

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן אָ֭רְחוֹת כָּל־ שֹׁ֣כְחֵי אֵ֑ל וְתִקְוַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף תֹּאבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kên ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ kāl- šō·ḵə·ḥê ’êl wə·ṯiq·waṯ ḥā·nêp̄ tō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: Such is the destiny of all who forget God so the hope of the godless will perish
verses.literalPt: Assim são as veredas de todos quantos se esquecem de Deus; e a esperança do hipócrita perecerá.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ יָק֥וֹט כִּסְל֑וֹ וּבֵ֥ית עַ֝כָּבִ֗ישׁ מִבְטַחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- yā·qō·wṭ kis·lōw ū·ḇêṯ ‘ak·kā·ḇîš miḇ·ṭa·ḥōw
verses.literal: His confidence is fragile his security is in a spider’s web
verses.literalPt: Cuja esperança fica frustrada; e a sua confiança será como a teia de aranha.

verses.original: יִשָּׁעֵ֣ן עַל־ בֵּ֭יתוֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֑ד יַחֲזִ֥יק בּ֝֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א יָקֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·šā·‘ên ‘al- bê·ṯōw wə·lō ya·‘ă·mōḏ ya·ḥă·zîq bōw wə·lō yā·qūm
verses.literal: He leans on his web but it gives way he holds fast but it does not endure
verses.literalPt: Encostar-se-á à sua casa, mas ela não subsistirá; apegar-se-á a ela, mas não ficará em pé.

verses.original: רָטֹ֣ב ה֭וּא לִפְנֵי־ שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְעַ֥ל גַּ֝נָּת֗וֹ יֹֽנַקְתּ֥וֹ תֵצֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: rā·ṭōḇ hū lip̄·nê- šā·meš wə·‘al gan·nā·ṯōw yō·naq·tōw ṯê·ṣê
verses.literal: He is a well-watered plant in the sunshine spreading its shoots over the garden
verses.literalPt: Ele é viçoso perante o sol, e os seus renovos saem sobre o seu jardim;

verses.original: עַל־ גַּ֭ל שָֽׁרָשָׁ֣יו יְסֻבָּ֑כוּ בֵּ֖ית אֲבָנִ֣ים יֶחֱזֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- gal šā·rā·šāw yə·sub·bā·ḵū bêṯ ’ă·ḇā·nîm ye·ḥĕ·zeh
verses.literal: His roots wrap around the rock heap he looks for a home among the stones
verses.literalPt: As suas raízes se entrelaçam, junto à fonte; para o pedregal atenta.

verses.original: אִם־ יְבַלְּעֶ֥נּוּ מִמְּקוֹמ֑וֹ וְכִ֥חֶשׁ בּ֝֗וֹ לֹ֣א רְאִיתִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yə·ḇal·lə·‘en·nū mim·mə·qō·w·mōw wə·ḵi·ḥeš bōw lō rə·’î·ṯî·ḵā
verses.literal: If he is uprooted from his place it will disown him saying, ‘ I never saw you
verses.literalPt: Se Deus o consumir do seu lugar, negá-lo-á este, dizendo: Nunca te vi!

verses.original: הֶן־ ה֭וּא מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּ֝מֵעָפָ֗ר אַחֵ֥ר יִצְמָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hen- hū mə·śō·wś dar·kōw ū·mê·‘ā·p̄ār ’a·ḥêr yiṣ·mā·ḥū
verses.literal: Surely this is the joy of his way yet others will spring from the dust
verses.literalPt: Eis que este é a alegria do seu caminho, e outros brotarão do pó.

verses.original: הֶן־ אֵ֭ל לֹ֣א יִמְאַס־ תָּ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ יַ֝חֲזִ֗יק בְּיַד־ מְרֵעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hen- ’êl lō yim·’as- tām wə·lō- ya·ḥă·zîq bə·yaḏ- mə·rê·‘îm
verses.literal: Behold God does not reject the blameless nor will He strengthen the hand of evildoers
verses.literalPt: Eis que Deus não rejeitará ao reto; nem toma pela mão aos malfeitores;

verses.original: עַד־ יְמַלֵּ֣ה שְׂח֣וֹק פִּ֑יךָ וּשְׂפָתֶ֥יךָ תְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- yə·mal·lêh śə·ḥō·wq pî·ḵā ū·śə·p̄ā·ṯe·ḵā ṯə·rū·‘āh
verses.literal: He will yet fill your mouth with laughter and your lips with a shout of joy
verses.literalPt: Até que de riso te encha a boca, e os teus lábios de júbilo.

verses.original: שֹׂנְאֶ֥יךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ־ בֹ֑שֶׁת וְאֹ֖הֶל רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֵינֶֽנּוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: śō·nə·’e·ḵā yil·bə·šū- ḇō·šeṯ wə·’ō·hel rə·šā·‘îm ’ê·nen·nū
verses.literal: Your enemies will be clothed in shame and the tent of the wicked will be no more
verses.literalPt: Os que te odeiam se vestirão de confusão, e a tenda dos ímpios não existirá mais.
